description: On-chain AI agent marketplace on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.31). initialize, register_agent, create_service, create_task, accept_task and complete_task payout are verified. A lab patch pays the system-owned escrow with an invoke_signed system transfer (offered upstream).
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration on the Blockchains/agentvault-protocol fork of sepivip/agentvault (the Blockchains/agentvault name was already taken by a fork of a different project). The lab only changed declare_id to the Sol.College devnet program. The hosted IDL is a hand-derived subset confirmed by the verifying transactions. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; fixes are offered upstream as ordinary pull requests and acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (initialize, register_agent, create_service, create_task, accept_task)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/agentvault/
QA: devnet proof of initialize, two register_agent calls, create_service, create_task, accept_task, and complete_task payout after an invoke_signed escrow fix
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Replace the complete_task system-account lamport debit with an invoke_signed system transfer so the escrow can settle
